pattern.description: The screen-recording card grows slightly (about 1%) inside the fixed branded background while the cursor travels to the top of the UI, starting a slow reframe toward the next area of interest.
pattern.why_premium: A gentle scale on the embedded UI card, rather than a hard cut, keeps the demo feeling alive and guides attention in step with the narration ('extracts the data') without disorienting the viewer.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.to(uiCard, {scale: 1.012, transformOrigin: '50% 50%', duration: 0.6, ease: 'power1.inOut'}) on the card only (background stays fixed); in parallel gsap.to(cursor, {x, y, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out'}).
build_hint.remotion: const s = interpolate(frame, [0, 18], [1, 1.012], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); apply transform: scale(s) to the UI card; cursor position via spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 26, stiffness: 170, mass: 1}}) with no overshoot.

notes: camera.move is none, so the scale is reported as the UI card scaling within the frame, not a camera push. Motion energy is still rising at the burst end (0.0136 on the last frame), so the scale likely continues past this event; the full reframe may belong with the next event. Cursor box is manual.
